title: Build the next affordable urban mobility brand
body:
India's cities are becoming increasingly crowded, and daily commuters struggle with expensive transportation, traffic congestion and unreliable public transport.

Your task: create a new electric mobility startup targeting college students and young working professionals.

Your startup must introduce an electric mobility product or service that:
• Is affordable and accessible to middle-class consumers.
• Offers a convenient alternative to autos and cabs for short-distance travel.
• Has a unique selling point compared to existing electric scooters.
• Has a sustainable and profitable business model.
• Can realistically expand to multiple Indian cities.

Develop a clear business proposal for your electric mobility startup. Your proposal must address the following six decisions:
01 What product or service are you launching?
02 Who is your target audience?
03 What will you name your brand?
04 What will be its pricing?
05 How will you market it and compete with existing brands?
06 How will you make money?

Expectation: a practical, commercially viable concept with a clear target market, pricing strategy, competitive positioning and revenue model.
